fields.description: Malaga is Bloom Living’s eleventh release and final premium villa collection. Mediterranean-inspired three- to six-bedroom homes connect indoor family spaces with their outdoor surroundings.

overview: The developer’s final-villa designation applies to Malaga; Alhambra is a separate later release with apartments, townhouses and penthouses.
research.locationNote: Within Bloom Living in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, near Zayed International Airport.
research.priceNote: The launch advertised from AED 4.1 million. The current developer six-bedroom guide starts at AED 8.7 million; this is not an entry price for every villa type.
research.paymentNote: The developer’s six-bedroom page gives 5 / 45 / 50. A broker instead lists 10 / 40 / 50 and 20 / 50 / 30 options. Confirm the applicable offer; no dated original instalment sheet was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: The developer launch targets Q4 2028; the broker guide targets Q2 2029. Confirm the contracted release and revised completion date.

facts.label: Finishing options
facts.value: The brochure includes Premium finishes by default. Upgraded interiors cost extra and require selection within the stated 90-day window.

facts.label: Tenure
facts.value: Bloom Living is an investment zone open to buyers of all nationalities.
